questions.q: On which day of creation did God make mankind?
questions.evidence: There was evening and there was morning, a sixth day

questions.q: What did God do on the seventh day?
questions.evidence: and he rested on the seventh day from all his work which he had done

questions.q: What did God take from the man to make the woman?
questions.evidence: As the man slept, he took one of his ribs, and closed up the flesh in its place
While they were in the field, Cain rose up against Abel, his brother, and killed him

questions.q: How long did the rain fall in the flood?
questions.evidence: It rained on the earth forty days and forty nights

questions.q: What did God set in the cloud as the sign of his covenant after the flood?
questions.evidence: I set my rainbow in the cloud, and it will be a sign of a covenant between me and the earth

questions.q: What was the city called where Yahweh confused the language of all the earth?
questions.evidence: Therefore its name was called Babel, because there Yahweh confused the language of all the earth

questions.q: How old was Abram when he departed from Haran?
questions.evidence: Abram was seventy-five years old when he departed from Haran

questions.q: What did Abraham name the son Sarah bore him?
questions.evidence: Abraham called his son who was born to him, whom Sarah bore to him, Isaac

questions.q: What did Abraham offer up instead of his son on the mountain?
questions.evidence: Abraham lifted up his eyes, and looked, and saw that behind him was a ram caught in the thicket by his horns

questions.q: What did Jacob give Esau in exchange for his birthright?
questions.evidence: Jacob gave Esau bread and stew of lentils

questions.q: After Jacob wrestled until daybreak, what new name was he given?
questions.evidence: He said, “Your name will no longer be called Jacob, but Israel

questions.q: What did Israel make for Joseph, the son he loved most?
questions.evidence: Now Israel loved Joseph more than all his children, because he was the son of his old age, and he made him a coat of many colors

questions.q: Over which land did Pharaoh set Joseph?
questions.evidence: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “Behold, I have set you over all the land of Egypt
